name: sol-advisor
description: Automatically matched Codex workflow for bounded functional subagents, primary-session implementation, and conditional cross-model verification.

interface.shortDescription: Automatically delegate bounded discovery, research, editing, and validation.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor automatically evaluates non-trivial repository work and dynamically routes functional custom agents for repository discovery, current external research, long-context analysis, deterministic mechanical edits, conditional DeepSeek adversarial verification, local code validation, and Sol evidence adjudication while the primary session owns complex implementation and final integration.
defaultPrompt: Handle this non-trivial repository task; let Sol Advisor automatically route only bounded supporting work.
Keep complex implementation in the primary session and validate any functional-agent dispatch plan.
Apply conditional cross-model verification only for material uncertainty or critical risk.
